selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: unprivileged appsvc user created with rootless podman prerequisites (subuid/subgid, cgroups)
selected_evidence.summary: Installed podman + rootless deps, enabled cgroups OpenRC service (cgroup2 mounted), created appsvc uid 1001 and populated /etc/subuid, /etc/subgid with 100000:65536

selected_evidence.requirement: Container runs as appsvc, serving on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Ran nginx:alpine as appsvc via rootless podman with -p 8080:80; curl to 127.0.0.1:8080 and NODE_IP:8080 both returned http_code=200

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session (initial setup + functional test)
selected_evidence.summary: Created /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp OpenRC service, added to default runlevel, verified rc-service stop/start correctly controls the container, and confirmed `who` shows no login session for appsvc while its processes (conmon, nginx master) run under uid appsvc
Captured boot_id 53c8268a..., service status started, HTTP 200 on both loopback and NODE_IP, appsvc-owned processes, no login session

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart 1: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, diagnosis of boot-start failure
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; boot_id changed from 53c8268a... to 0e7f2a28...; discovered appsvc-webapp failed to auto-start due to checkpath failing on freshly-created /run tmpfs

selected_evidence.requirement: Fix applied and validated after restart 1
selected_evidence.summary: Replaced checkpath with explicit mkdir/chown/chmod in start_pre; service started successfully; HTTP 200 confirmed on loopback and NODE_IP with appsvc-owned processes and no login session

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart 2: proof the fixed boot script is truly persistent across a real reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-reboot baseline (boot_id 0e7f2a28..., status started, HTTP 200); reboot acknowledged; after reconnect boot_id changed to 601c9539...; appsvc-webapp auto-started via OpenRC default runlevel with no manual intervention, HTTP 200 confirmed on loopback and NODE_IP, processes owned by appsvc, and no login session present

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
APPSVC_UID=$(id -u appsvc)
echo "== STEP write OpenRC init script =="
cat > /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp <<EOF
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="appsvc-webapp"
description="Rootless podman web app running as appsvc on port 8080"
appsvc_uid="${APPSVC_UID}"
runtime_dir="/run/user/\${appsvc_uid}"

depend() {
	need net cgroups
	after firewall
}

start_pre() {
	checkpath -d -m 0700 -o appsvc:appsvc "\${runtime_dir}"
}

start() {
	ebegin "Starting appsvc-webapp container"
	su -s /bin/sh appsvc -c "export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=\${runtime_dir}; export HOME=/home/appsvc; podman start webapp"
	eend \$?
}

stop() {
	ebegin "Stopping appsvc-webapp container"
	su -s /bin/sh appsvc -c "export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=\${runtime_dir}; export HOME=/home/appsvc; podman stop webapp"
	eend \$?
}

status() {
	su -s /bin/sh appsvc -c "export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=\${runtime_dir}; export HOME=/home/appsvc; podman inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' webapp" 2>/dev/null | grep -q true && einfo "status: started" || einfo "status: stopped"
}
EOF
chmod 755 /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp
rc-update add appsvc-webapp default
echo "== STEP verify service registered =="
rc-update show default | grep appsvc-webapp
echo "== STEP validate script syntax =="
openrc-run --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sh -n /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp && echo "syntax OK (sh -n)"

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
APPSVC_UID=$(id -u appsvc)
cat > /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp <<EOF
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="appsvc-webapp"
description="Rootless podman web app running as appsvc on port 8080"
appsvc_uid="${APPSVC_UID}"
runtime_dir="/run/user/\${appsvc_uid}"

depend() {
	need net cgroups
	after firewall
}

start_pre() {
	mkdir -p "\${runtime_dir}"
	chown appsvc:appsvc "\${runtime_dir}"
	chmod 700 "\${runtime_dir}"
}

start() {
	ebegin "Starting appsvc-webapp container"
	su -s /bin/sh appsvc -c "export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=\${runtime_dir}; export HOME=/home/appsvc; podman start webapp"
	eend \$?
}

stop() {
	ebegin "Stopping appsvc-webapp container"
	su -s /bin/sh appsvc -c "export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=\${runtime_dir}; export HOME=/home/appsvc; podman stop webapp"
	eend \$?
}

status() {
	su -s /bin/sh appsvc -c "export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=\${runtime_dir}; export HOME=/home/appsvc; podman inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' webapp" 2>/dev/null | grep -q true && einfo "status: started" || einfo "status: stopped"
}
EOF
chmod 755 /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp
sh -n /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp && echo "syntax OK"

echo "== zap and start =="
rc-service appsvc-webapp zap || true
rc-service appsvc-webapp start
echo "start_exit=$?"
sleep 2
rc-service appsvc-webapp status
